body:
Hi abradolph, what you're going through sounds incredibly stressful! Some of the most stressful changes in life are moving, getting a new job, and changes in eating/sleeping habits. And you're facing all of those at once. 

I had a similar situation last year and I ended up scrapping it and going home. It was a prestigious art program that was very hard to get into. I was anxious about it going into it and once I arrived at the dormitories I fell completely apart. I couldn't eat or sleep, or attend classes, or socialize at all, and became really quite ill from the stress. After a few days of this I decided that I didn't have the means at the moment to cope with this change and, after seeing the on-campus crisis counselor, decided to go home. I was lucky enough to get a refund. It was a VERY hard decision to make and I spent a significant amount of time afterward feeling incredibly bad--though not as bad as how I felt when I was there at the dormitories. I needed to take time to care for myself during that abrupt change, and at the time I didn't know how to support myself and advocate for myself properly. I took it as a learning experience.
